title: Late blast and leaf blight in the eastern towns
body: Neck blast and bacterial leaf blight were confirmed in late August and September on rainfed fields in Laur, Bongabon, Lupao, Gabaldon, Rizal, and Palayan City. Fields planted in early August are still in a susceptible stage. Irrigated fields planted in June are past it.

title: Brown planthopper above the October level in the northwest
body: Hopper counts remain above the usual October level in Guimba, Science City of Muñoz, Talavera, Cuyapo, San Jose City, Santo Domingo, and Quezon. Recheck dense canopies before a second application. A washing rain is not in the current forecast.

title: Standing water on low fields south of Cabanatuan
body: Standing water remains in parts of Cabiao, San Antonio, Zaragoza, Jaen, and San Isidro. Drain before harvest where the grain is already hard. Upland towns are not in this note.

title: Wet-season harvest underway on the irrigated plain
body: Cutting has started on June plantings in Guimba, Cuyapo, Muñoz, Talavera, San Jose City, Quezon, Licab, and Nampicuan. Finish mature fields before the next rainy spell and dry the grain off the ground.
